exampleEn: I have to hit the books tonight because I have a test tomorrow.
exampleKo: 나는 내일 시험이 있어서 오늘 밤에 열심히 공부해야 해.
gameExamples: Before the exam week starts, I need to hit the books every evening.
She decided to hit the books earlier this semester to avoid last-minute stress.
To improve my grades, I promised myself to hit the books regularly from now on.
